key_decisions.decision: Keeps priest in the official roster with its syntactic ambiguity noted.
Keeps priest and king’s friend as stated offices rather than flattening both to adviser.
Preserves the difficult closing administrative statement without silently inserting Judah.
Keeps forty thousand from the pin without harmonizing Chronicles.
Retains the second equine term without asserting a breed.
Preserves the heart image and its echoed sand comparison.
Makes the emissary relationship readable without reducing the universal rhetoric.
